name_zh: 古尔巴/和解/真相委员会：乌班图真相和解与后冲突重建
name_en: Gbagbo/Reconciliation/Truth Commission: Ubuntu Truth & Reconciliation & Post-Conflict Reconstruction
description_zh: 洛朗·古尔巴 (1945-) 科特迪瓦总统 (2000-2011)，2010-2011 后选举危机/内战/3000+ 死亡/国际刑事法院受审/无罪释放。查尔斯·布拉·古德 (1952-) 真相、对话与和解委员会 (CVR) 主席 (2013-2014)，推动受害者倾听/加害者认罪/社区和解/赔偿/制度改革。体现 M146 乌班图真相和解——以"受害者倾听+加害者认罪+社区和解+赔偿制度"四位一体，在选举暴力/民族冲突/国际审判三重阴影下构建本土和解路径。
description_en: Laurent Gbagbo (1945-) Côte d'Ivoire President (2000-2011), 2010-2011 post-election crisis/civil war/3000+ deaths/ICC trial/acquitted. Charles Blé Goudé (1952-) Truth, Dialogue and Reconciliation Commission (CVR) Chair (2013-2014), drove victim hearings/perpetrator confessions/community reconciliation/reparations/institutional reforms. Exemplifies M146 Ubuntu Truth & Reconciliation—quaternity of 'victim listening + perpetrator confession + community reconciliation + reparations system' constructing indigenous reconciliation path amid election violence/ethnic conflict/international trial triple shadows.
reason_zh: 科特迪瓦真相和解非单纯模仿南非，而是"受害者声音+社区仪式+传统调解+赔偿实质"四位一体本土化和解。CVR 走访村庄/听取证词/传统酋长主持/赔偿牛/钱/土地/公共服务。M146 区隔于 M146 乌班图(共识)、M191 记忆修复(戈雷岛)、M187 酋长制(阿散蒂)，核心在于"受害者倾听优先+社区仪式主导+传统调解介入+赔偿实质化"的后冲突本土和解范式。
reason_en: Côte d'Ivoire truth & reconciliation not mere South Africa copy but 'victim voices + community rituals + traditional mediation + substantive reparations' quaternity indigenized reconciliation. CVR visited villages/heard testimonies/traditional chiefs presided/reparations cattle/money/land/public services. M146 distinct from M146 Ubuntu (consensus), M191 Memory Repair (Goree), M187 Chiefship (Asante), core: 'victim listening priority + community rituals lead + traditional mediation intervenes + reparations substantiated' post-conflict indigenous reconciliation paradigm.
steps_zh: 受害者倾听优先：CVR 走访 1000+ 村庄/收集 7 万+ 证词/受害者优先发言/心理支持/性暴力专门机制
社区仪式主导：传统酋长/长者/宗教领袖主持/倾倒祭酒/呼唤祖先/公开认罪/拥抱和解/社区宴席
传统调解介入：酋长法庭/长老会议/习法/赔偿标准/牛/钱/土地/公共服务/跨族群通婚
赔偿制度实质化：国家赔偿基金/受害者登记/医疗/教育/住房/就业/心理/象征性/物质性双轨
制度改革与防再发：选举法/宪法/安全部队改革/媒体/司法/土地/国籍/身份证/选民登记/预警机制
steps_en: Victim listening priority: CVR visited 1000+ villages/collected 70k+ testimonies/victims speak first/psychological support/sexual violence specialized mechanism
Community rituals lead: traditional chiefs/elders/religious leaders preside/libation/ancestor invocation/public confession/embrace reconciliation/community feast
Traditional mediation intervenes: chiefly courts/elders councils/customary law/reparation standards/cattle/money/land/public services/inter-clan marriages
Reparations system substantiated: state reparations fund/victim registry/medical/education/housing/employment/psychological/symbolic/material dual-track
Institutional reforms & non-recurrence: electoral law/constitution/security sector reform/media/judiciary/land/nationality/ID cards/voter registration/early warning mechanisms
expected_zh: 以"受害者倾听+社区仪式+传统调解+赔偿实质"四位一体，在选举暴力/民族冲突/国际审判三重阴影下构建本土和解路径，为后冲突非洲国家提供非复制式和解范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'victim listening + community rituals + traditional mediation + substantive reparations' constructs indigenous reconciliation path amid election violence/ethnic conflict/international trial triple shadows, providing non-copycat reconciliation paradigm for post-conflict African nations.
case_zh: 2010-11 后选举危机/3000+ 死亡/古尔巴 ICC 受审/无罪释放/2013-14 CVR 运行/7 万+ 证词/赔偿启动/2020s 瓦塔拉三连任/和解未完成/民族张力存续，本土和解艰难前行。
case_en: 2010-11 post-election crisis/3000+ deaths/Gbagbo ICC trial/acquitted/2013-14 CVR operation/70k+ testimonies/reparations launched/2020s Ouattara third term/reconciliation incomplete/ethnic tensions persist, indigenous reconciliation difficult journey.
intellectual_tradition: Ivorian Truth & Reconciliation / Ubuntu Justice / Post-Conflict Reconstruction
cross_cultural_impact: African TRC indigenization; victim-centered approach; traditional mediation in TRC; reparations substantiation
colonial_history: French Ivory Coast 1893-1960; forced labor; cocoa/coffee plantations
diaspora_influence: Ivorian diaspora 2M+ (FR/US/CA/BE); diaspora testimonies to CVR
indigenous_knowledge_system: Baoulé matrilineal; traditional mediation; communal consensus; cattle as reparation
oral_tradition: Baoulé oral testimony; community authorization: CVR Commission 2023
